description: Zero-shot CLIP feature vocabulary. One label per visually distinct feature in the dataset. Thresholds are raw cosine acceptance cut-offs, never probabilities; null means the feature cannot be emitted until tuned on human labels.

features.label: sculptural carvings
prompts: a photograph of intricate stone sculptures carved into an Indian temple wall
close-up of detailed relief carvings of figures and motifs on a heritage monument
ancient hand-carved stone sculpture decorating a historic Indian building
carved stone panels with human figures and ornamental patterns on a temple
negative_prompts: a plain flat stone wall with no carved figures or relief decoration
a smooth undecorated masonry surface on a modern building

features.label: jali work
prompts: a photograph of a pierced stone lattice screen with geometric patterns
ornate jali stone latticework window in an Indian monument
carved stone screen with intricate perforated lattice patterns
close-up of a stone jali screen with patterned openings
negative_prompts: a solid stone wall with no perforated screen or lattice openings
a plain window opening without carved stone tracery

features.label: staircases
prompts: a photograph of stone steps leading down into a stepwell
a long flight of worn stone stairs in a historic Indian building
symmetrical stone staircase with landings inside a heritage stepwell
ancient stone steps and terraces descending into a stepwell
negative_prompts: a flat stone floor or terrace with no steps or stairs
a single low threshold step in front of a doorway

features.label: domes
prompts: a photograph of a large stone dome on an Indian heritage building
rounded dome rising above a historic mosque or tomb
carved stone dome with a finial on a heritage monument
view of a historic Indian dome against the sky
negative_prompts: a flat roof or straight-sided building without a dome
a pointed spire or tower with no rounded roof

features.label: stone arches
prompts: a photograph of carved stone arches in a historic Indian building
a row of ornate stone archways inside a monument
pointed stone arch supported by carved columns
ancient stone arch entrance of a heritage site
negative_prompts: a rectangular stone doorway with a flat lintel and no arch
a plain wall with no arched opening

features.label: carved pillars
prompts: a photograph of carved stone pillars inside a historic Indian monument
a row of ornate stone columns with sculpted capitals
close-up of a decorated stone pillar in a temple
ancient stone columns supporting a carved roof
negative_prompts: a plain unadorned stone wall with no columns or pillars
a smooth concrete column in a modern building

features.label: decorative brackets
prompts: a photograph of carved stone brackets supporting a balcony
ornate corbels and brackets under the eaves of a heritage building
decorative carved stone supports on an Indian palace facade
close-up of sculpted stone brackets on a historic building
negative_prompts: a flat wall-to-roof junction with no projecting carved supports
a plain ceiling with no brackets or corbels
